edition: IS 808:2021 (4th revision) rolled sections; IS 4923:1997 SHS/RHS; IS 1161:2014 CHS
source: Published tables (see 'sources' and skyframe/docs/SECTION_SOURCES.md). Values not printed by the source are computed exactly from the published dimensions and listed per shape in 'computed'. Designations are those printed in IS 808:2021 (e.g. 'MB 300'); families use the series names (ISMB = MB series, ISMC = MC series, ISA = angles). Where IS 808 prints the same designation for several weights the mass (kg/m) is appended to keep names unique.

sources.OSDAG-808: IS 808:2021 (Dimensions for hot rolled steel beam, column, channel and angle sections, 4th revision) tables as transcribed in the Osdag database (FOSSEE / IIT Bombay, LGPL-3.0), osdag-admin/Osdag @fd1a7d8, src/osdag/data/ResourceFiles/Database/Intg_osdag.sql, tables Beams / Columns / Channels / EqualAngle / UnequalAngle (Source column 'IS808_Rev')
sources.OSDAG-4923: IS 4923:1997 hollow steel sections (SHS, RHS) as transcribed in the Osdag database, same file, tables SHS / RHS (Source 'IS 4923:1997')
sources.OSDAG-1161: IS 1161:2014 steel tubes (CHS) as transcribed in the Osdag database, same file, table CHS (Source 'IS 1161:2014')

conventions: local 3 = major axis (IS z-z), 2 = minor (IS y-y); d along local 2. flange_slope_deg = inclination of the inner flange face (published 'flange slope' minus 90 deg). Channels: back of web at 3=0, flanges toward +3. Angles: heel at origin, leg d (IS 'a') along +2, leg b along +3; I33/I22 = IS Iz/Iy about leg-parallel centroidal axes, alpha = angle (rad) from local 3 to the major principal axis, positive toward +2. x0/y0 = shear centre minus centroid along 3/2. As2 = d*tw, As3 = 5/3*bf*tf (I/channel); 5/6*d*t, 5/6*b*t (angle); 2*d*t, 2*b*t (RHS); A/2 (CHS). SHS/RHS corner radii r_out = 2t, r_in = t reproduce the tabulated areas and are used for the computed J.
